title: My Soul Waits for God Alone

questions.question: For God alone my soul waits in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:1 (ESV): "For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation."

questions.question: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I shall not be greatly what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:2 (ESV): "...my fortress; I shall not be greatly shaken."

questions.question: How long will all of you attack a man to batter him, like a leaning what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:3 (ESV): "...like a leaning wall, a tottering fence?"

questions.question: They bless with their mouths, but inwardly they do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:4 (ESV): "They bless with their mouths, but inwardly they curse."

questions.question: For God alone, O my soul, wait in silence, for my hope is from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:5 (ESV): "For God alone, O my soul, wait in silence, for my hope is from him."

questions.question: Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your heart before him; God is a what for us?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:8 (ESV): "...God is a refuge for us."

questions.question: Those of low estate are but a breath; those of high estate are a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:9 (ESV): "Those of low estate are but a breath; those of high estate are a delusion;"

questions.question: In the balances they go up; they are together lighter than a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:9 (ESV): "in the balances they go up; they are together lighter than a breath."

questions.question: Put no trust in extortion; set no vain hopes on what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:10 (ESV): "Put no trust in extortion; set no vain hopes on robbery;"

questions.question: If riches increase, set not your heart on whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:10 (ESV): "if riches increase, set not your heart on them."

questions.question: Once God has spoken; twice have I heard this: that power belongs to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:11 (ESV): "Once God has spoken; twice have I heard this: that power belongs to God,"

questions.question: And that to you, O Lord, belongs what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:12 (ESV): "and that to you, O Lord, belongs steadfast love."

questions.question: For you will render to a man according to his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:12 (ESV): "For you will render to a man according to his work."

questions.question: This Psalm is according to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62 Title: "To the choirmaster: according to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David."

questions.question: They only plan to thrust him down from his high what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 62:4 (ESV): "They only plan to thrust him down from his high position."

key_verse_text: For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation.
